renders.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Use ONLY the claims in the ESSENCE list below; every paragraph must correspond to at least one essence item (record indices). Do not add doctrines, comparisons, meta-commentary, or quoted terms. ESSENCE: [0] Measured-unmeasured contemplated; supreme freedom trusted. [1] Timeless sequence held self-independent. [2] Supreme pair unioned between other powers. [3] Bliss-willed vague-clear flashed by difference. [4] Joined feeling lives; full body. [5] Flashed abiding grossly fivefolds.

paragraphs.text: Think through both the measured and the unmeasured, then trust supreme freedom to do the going. Inside and outside, hold the timeless sequence as self-standing, needing nothing else.
At the center, the supreme pair in union, with the other powers ranged between. Bliss wills indistinctness, then flashes distinct by difference — vague, then clear.
Joined feeling lives on; the body is full. Flash, abide, go gross — and the gross goes fivefold.
